# Camp Resources: The Nodding Donkey

Up and down the Nodding Donkey just cannot fall asleep!

Generates Oil and Nuclear Waste.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__The Nodding Donkey__

**Produces**

Oil

Nuclear Waste

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

2 Pounds (mix of Oil and Nuclear Waste).

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - __The Nodding Donkey__ - 500 Atoms

Atom Shop - __The Candle Making Bundle__ - 1500 Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
